blocks.text: Real-world analogue: An eroding coastal settlement, an abandoned weather station, an island losing land to the sea, a cliff archive collapsing during a storm, and a fog-shrouded evacuation harbor.
World relation: Continuity struggles to preserve witness; Open World ethics make the rescue a shared responsibility; Quiet World caution explains why every rescue route cannot simply be exposed.

Connection to newer locations: Orison can be visually and historically echoed by the Basalt Memory Coast, Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Glacial Memory Fjord, Inland Sea of Doors, and Mosaic Worldscar.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: A place can cease to exist without making its people unreal. Rescue does not restore the lost land exactly; it carries relationships, disagreements, and changed survivors forward.
